$note: Additions to docs/design/build-handoff/tokens.json from the chat-mode handoff (DL-119). Nothing existing changes. Points. Contrast is against the fill named.

chatGround.usage: The chat transcript's ground, so chat mode stands apart from the white panes beside it (Sep 1b). An alias, not a new colour.

chatYou.usage: Your messages' bubble, and your answers to review cards (You chose …). Not the accent: needsYou keeps its one meaning.

diffDelText.usage: Removed-line text, −n counts, a failed tool's status and error text

toolErrorEdge.usage: The border of a failed tool's output box (decoration; the text says failed)

chatBubble.usage: Your message: rounded, with a sharp bottom-right corner that points at you

chatCard.usage: Claude's reply card: its sharp bottom-left corner mirrors the bubble

reviewCard.usage: A permission, plan or question card docked at the bottom, with a 1.5 needsYou border

chatCardTrailing.usage: Space kept to the right of Claude's card (Geoff: half the first board's skew)

chatHeading.usage: Headings in Claude's Markdown, as drawn (other levels: Q-56)

chatMeta.usage: You · 9:41, Claude · 9:42, tool steps, status lines
